statement.zh: Parrot《马里考古团》第 I 卷（1956）正式报告马里伊什塔尔神庙发掘；宫殿档案卷为另册，不在本主张范围内。
statement.en: Parrot’s Mission archéologique de Mari vol. I (1956) is the primary report on the Temple of Ishtar at Mari; palace-archive volumes are separate and out of scope for this claim.

editorial.notes: Fact about Mari Ishtar temple volume scope.
